claims.statement: Sungkawichai-Trakulthongchai (S-T), arXiv 2604.23906 v2, Defs. 2.1 and 2.3: Z_{p,l} = {x in Z_{lp} : x not = 0 mod p}; v in Z_{p,l}^k is (k,p,l)-proper iff some i has gcd(l, v_j : j != i) > 1 or some t in (1/(lp))Z has ||t v_i|| >= 1/(k+1) for all i; I(k,p,l) = improper tuples; J(k,p) = v in Z_{p,1}^k with v in pi_{lp -> p} I(k,p,l) for every l. Table 1, row k = 10: P_10 = the 61 primes 127..467.

S-T results used: Lemma 2.4 (J = empty iff I(k,p,l) = empty for some l); Corollary 2.5 (if LRC(k-1) holds and J(k,p) = empty then p divides u_1...u_k for every counterexample u); Proposition 2.7 (if LRC(k-1) holds, J(k,p) = empty for all p in P and prod P >= B_k then LRC(k) holds); Lemma 2.2 (pre-jump); Remark 3.2 and Section 5.2 (the k = 10 plan x2 x2 x2 /8 leaves only the class of (1..10)); Propositions 1.4/4.1/4.4 and Lemma 4.3 (the identity fibre at level k+1 = 11).

Premises of the chain to LRC(10) (the conjecture for 11 runners): LRC(9) (10 runners), Trakulthongchai, Electron. J. Combin. 33(2) P2.46; Lemma 2.6 = Malikiosis-Santos-Schymura Theorem A in the form of Rosenfeld arXiv 2509.14111 Corollary 3: a counterexample has prod u_i < B_k with B_k = (C(k+1,2)^(k-1) / k)^k, division by k and not k! (confirmed in three texts: Rosenfeld Cor. 3, Trakulthongchai arXiv 2511.22427 C_k, Allikvere arXiv 2609.02604). With the computation J(10,p) = empty (Tier C) and prod P_10 >= B_10 (Tier A) the chain gives LRC(10), which is S-T's Theorem 1.3 for k = 10: NOT a new result.

Soundness of the producer's own pruning in phase 1 (set-canonical supports; capacity bound; hitting-set branching with sibling exclusion): every class of I(k,p,1) has a set-canonical member; for distinct x, y in a set-canonical U, fold(y/x) >= u_2; multiplicities travel with the support; the capacity bound is a valid relaxation. Re-derived by the AI auditor (AUDIT.md section 2b) and checked empirically by three-mode agreement on 56 (k,p) cases and by the auditor's pairwise-lemma-free runs at p = 127, 137.

Phase 1 and lifts (plan 2,2,2,/) for k = 10 at all 61 primes of P_10 end with exactly one class, the canonical (1,...,10) (only_identity true, identity_survives true); |S_1| (classes of I(10,p,1)) ranges from 1 to 58,087 (max at p = 137); main pass 3,963 core-s; the unpruned second pass agrees with the main pass at class-hash level for 33 of 61 primes (127..307) and was stopped. Own-algorithm re-computation by the auditor at p = 127, 137, 263 only; the other 58 primes (incl. 467) rest on the producer's code.

The level-11 fibre over (1,...,10) is (10,p,11)-proper at all 61 primes of P_10: fiber_check enumerates all 2,593,742,461 vectors w in (Z_11)^10 up to Z_11^* scaling, 0 improper at each prime (158,218,290,121 vectors in all); cross-check by the generic x11 lift at p = 127 (25,937,424,601 lifts, 0 survivors). Together with LRI-C-0002 this gives J(10,p) = empty without Proposition 1.4. Independent: the auditor's own fibre program at p = 127, 137, 263, 467 (0 improper), exhaustive S-T Prop. 4.1 for k = 10 (15,937,424,600 vectors, 0 failures) and the Lemma 4.3 inclusion at all 61 primes.

What the independent AI auditor recomputed with its own code and different algorithms: phase 1 + lifts at p = 127, 137, 263 (identical class counts and hashes at every level, S1 = 8,228 / 58,087 / 17; unpruned at 127 and 137); all 214 positive-control cases k = 3..8, with and without the pairwise lemma (214/214 identical); level-11 fibre at p = 127, 137, 263, 467 (+53, 97): 0 improper; S-T Prop. 4.1 exhaustive; Lemma 4.3 at all 61 primes; no-symmetry brute force I(4,13,5) = empty over 12,960,000 ordered tuples. NOT done: its own phase 1 at the other 58 primes (p = 467 infeasible, stopped at 1,898 s).

Controls, run before the headline: positive, per-prime verdict patterns for k = 3..8 against Rosenfeld and Trakulthongchai (column 'I(k,p,l_final) = empty at the tested level'; k = 4, p = 13 flag withdrawn: Rosenfeld section 7 is hedged and makes no claim about 13, brute force I(4,13,5) = empty, controls_ok true); negative, planted mutations MUT=1 ('<' to '<=') and MUT=2 (floor for ceil) change the counts at k = 7, 8 and MUT=2 removes the identity at k = 10, both inert at the level-11 step, which has no mutation switch; the strict '>' control at p = 127, L = 11 flags exactly the identity orbit w = -(1..10); nonzero fibre counts agree in two independent programs (p = 13: 54,976; p = 23: 7,210); L = 5, 7 survivor control.

Comparison with the S-T logs (github.com/vzsky/13-lonely-runners, results/result_11), opened by the auditor only after its own counts at p = 127 and 137: S-T 'Step 1 (l=1): S size' equals the producer's S1_classes at all 61 primes, 0 disagreements; their log reports 'Subproof Mod p Done' for all 61. Later sizes are not comparable (S-T remove the identity before lifting). The producer did not read the repository (attestation, not verifiable by the auditor).

Optional premise re-run (a check, not a derivation): lr_sieve 9 p 2,5 gives an empty final set at all 47 primes of Trakulthongchai's S_9 (137..401), 214 core-seconds. LRC(9) remains a literature premise; the re-run was not audited.

HEADLINE. J(10,p) = empty for every one of the 61 primes p in P_10 = {127,...,467} (exact integer arithmetic, exhaustive enumeration; the Proposition 1.4 step of S-T is replaced by a direct level-11 fibre computation), by an independently written implementation, independently AI-audited. This is a replication of S-T's computational input for k = 10, NOT a new theorem. With the Tier L premises LRC(9), the MSS/Rosenfeld bound B_k and S-T Cor. 2.5 / Prop. 2.7, and prod P_10 >= B_10 (Tier A, LRI-A-0001), the chain gives LRC(10), the conjecture for 11 runners (k = 10 moving speeds plus the stationary runner), i.e. S-T's Theorem 1.3 for k = 10; the lonely runner conjecture in general is open.
